::: {#def-teacher-forcing}

#### Teacher forcing

**Teacher forcing** trains a recurrent [language model](#def-language-model) on a text by feeding it the true text as input,
and asking it at each position for the next symbol of the same text
[@goodfellow2016deep, section 10.2.1].
The targets are the inputs moved one position on.
The model never reads its own predictions during training.

:::
